chunks: And in the narration of Hammad, from Hariz, in a hadith, he says at its end:
"Indeed, the guaranteed hady is not to be eaten from when it perishes; so if he eats from it, he must compensate."

key_terms.الْمَضْمُونَ: that for which liability or guarantee applies
key_terms.الْهَدْيَ: the sacrificial animal offered in relation to hajj
key_terms.عَطِبَ: it became ruined, disabled, or perished

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating from a guaranteed hady animal if it perishes before reaching its place?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the guaranteed hady animal if it becomes ruined or perishes. It states that one may not eat from such an animal, and if one does eat from it, compensation becomes obligatory.
